units.characteristics: God's holiness and name vindicated; the hidden face no more; the Spirit poured out
units.gist: the Gog oracles (the last great assault defeated); the inner-being note is God's own concern - 'I will show my GREATNESS and my HOLINESS and make myself known'; 'my HOLY NAME I will make known... I will NOT LET MY HOLY NAME BE PROFANED anymore'; and the tender promise - 'I will NOT HIDE MY FACE ANYMORE from them, when I POUR OUT MY SPIRIT upon the house of Israel' - the hidden face (that judgment withdrew) now permanently turned toward his people, his Spirit poured out

units.characteristics: the glory returns to dwell forever; the vision meant to produce shame and repentance
units.gist: GEM (counterpart to the departing glory of 10-11) - the new-temple vision; 'the GLORY of the God of Israel was COMING FROM THE EAST... the earth SHONE with his glory... the glory of the LORD FILLED THE TEMPLE'; 'this is the place of my THRONE... where I will DWELL in the midst of Israel FOREVER'; and its purpose - 'describe the temple, THAT THEY MAY BE ASHAMED of their iniquities... if they are ashamed, make known to them the design' - the presence that left now returns to dwell, the holy vision meant to humble

units.characteristics: God himself as inheritance; the river of life from his presence; the consummation - the LORD is there
units.gist: THE GEM - the temple ordinances (the priests who distinguish holy/common; 'I AM THEIR INHERITANCE... I am their possession'); then the RIVER from the temple threshold, deepening from a trickle to a river, bringing LIFE and FRESHNESS wherever it flows ('wherever the river goes, everything will LIVE'), trees on both banks whose 'leaves will not wither... but they will bear fresh fruit every month, for the water flows from the sanctuary'; and the book's final word - the city named 'THE LORD IS THERE'
